_note: Daily missions: three a game day (09:00 GST to 09:00), picked on the server from your current goal (public.my_missions()) and checked against what you did that day. Each pays 'xp' league points; doing all three opens the mystery box (AED by the odds below, shown to players, plus box.xp). Savings: money moved out of your wallet into a jar that counts toward the Save up goal; payday offers the 'shares' when wages arrive. Mirrored in supabase/migrations/*_missions.sql (scripts/check-life-config.mjs).
